versions.subject: rule: BlackByte ransomware
versions.detection:
selection1:
  Image|startswith: 'C:\Users\Public\'
  CommandLine|endswith: ' -single'
selection2:
  CommandLine|contains:
    - 'del C:\Windows\System32\Taskmgr.exe'
    - ';Set-Service -StartupType Disabled $'
    - 'powershell -command "$x =[System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String('
    - ' do start wordpad.exe /p '
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: (Image="C:\\Users\\Public\\*" CommandLine="* -single") OR CommandLine IN ("*del C:\\Windows\\System32\\Taskmgr.exe*", "*;Set-Service -StartupType Disabled $*", "*powershell -command \"$x =[System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(*", "* do start wordpad.exe /p *")
